originalScores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptionally clear and comfortable across assessed content. Scores are holistic judgments of these two synthetic paused attempts, not win/loss grades, benchmarks or physical-device certification.

overallMobile.reason: Coherent playable mission with useful touch assists and strong progress feedback; target recognition and camera/control coordination remain noticeable friction. Paused observation limits confidence about sustained comfort.

controls.reason: Two-contact MOVE/FIRE drag, scene swipe, AIM and DASH visibly responded. Zoomed patrol engagement worked. Scenery mis-target, cover shots and burst lift prompt prevented a friction-free assessment; continuous rearming remains unassessed.

gameplay.reason: Recovery, coil disable and deck upload form a clear changing objective sequence. Patrol combat and incomplete coil/reload correction added decisions. Much traversal was assisted; broader tactics, balance and continuous enjoyment unassessed.

presentation.reason: Rainy relay architecture, teal lighting, wet-looking surfaces, weapon view and consistent HUD give a cohesive atmosphere. Gray scenery reduces target separation. Audio and hardware frame pacing unassessed.

usability.reason: Large labeled controls, contextual route/approach action, paused planning map, automatic reload, objective updates and clear START FRESH/result stats helped completion. Dense right-side actions and LAST-vs-current threat interpretation add friction.

readability.reason: Objectives, health/ammo, survivor checks, coil percentages and upload bar read clearly. Small world labels, map details and gray patrol silhouettes were harder at 844x390.

coverage.manualCombat: Entry guard down during simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag. Patrol first tap hit scenery/fixture (19→18 ammo), then visible guard retargeted with MOVE and FIRE drag, LAST SENTINEL DOWN (18→15). Final deck guard tapped and fired before win; no separate elimination attribution.
coverage.turn: Scene swipe changed heading 339→355. FIRE drag also changed view.
coverage.dash: Tapped after entry kill; displacement, teal flash and 4.3 cooldown visible. No verified evade; terminal phase evades 0.
coverage.aim: Zoom visible. Re-engaged after pause and fired 900ms into cover, 21→19 ammo, COVER AIM CLEAR. No zoomed enemy hit confirmed.
coverage.assistedCompletion: Route/approach holds, coil taps with anchored FIRE, auto reload, deck upload.

failures: Patrol first tap selected scenery rather than guard.
Ignored rear threats while routing; shield fell to 41 and later 28.
helpfulMoments: Entry instruction gave tap/hold/turn/DASH guidance beside large controls.
TARGET DOWN and SENTINEL DOWN provided kill feedback.
Route/approach button changed with proximity and survivor checks confirmed recovery.
Map showed 15m walking route and low-cover legend.
Numbered coil AIM markers and OFF feedback made boss progress legible.
Upload percentage and STAY ON DECK made final goal explicit.
frustratingMoments: Mistook a fixture for a patrol target against gray scenery.
Zoomed shots struck cover rather than an enemy.
Threats behind the view required interpretation/turning while route movement changed heading.
Small world signs and map details were harder to read at 844x390.

coverage.dash: Tapped with CHARGE FRONT LEFT cue then held route. Later cooldown 1.6 visible; full health/shield at approach. Terminal phase evades 0: no successful phase evade established.
coverage.aim: Visible zoomed FIRE engagement with TARGET DOWN. No new scene coordinate chosen after zoom in that batch; anchored FIRE drag.
coverage.turn: Tap aim changed heading 90→33; no separate scene swipe this attempt (sampled in attempt one).
